items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: he always called me brother. And he had sent this Easter egg to us for Easter Sunday.

ctx.x: And he had given my wife and I a Easter egg, saying -- he always called me brother. And he had sent this Easter egg to us for Easter Sunday. That was on Easter Sunday and he went to the concert and he dropped dead. I went to help identify his body with his father at the morgue, to get his things and all that.
Duke Grohner said that Sid was standing with Duke and his wife. And he just --
Keeled over, right, right. Well, that was what happened with Lil Armstrong, you remember?
